titre: Legally recognizing my child when we are not married
resume: Free of charge, recognition (reconnaissance) establishes the father's legal parentage. In Mayotte, a specific rule: outside the birth registration, it is done at the Mamoudzou town hall and its registration can be suspended by the public prosecutor.
aQuoiCaSert: When the parents are not married, the father's legal parentage is not automatic: he must recognize the child. The mother has nothing to do if her name appears on the birth certificate. Recognition can be done before the birth, when the birth is registered, or later. If done before the child's first birthday, it allows the father to exercise parental authority jointly with the mother. In Mayotte, the law of August 11, 2025 on planning for the rebuilding of Mayotte (loi de programmation pour la refondation de Mayotte) set out specific rules.
quiEstConcerne: A mother who wishes to make a prenatal recognition (optional).
Female couples: a joint prenatal recognition before a notary is required.
aSavoir: In Mayotte, a recognition made before a civil registrar (officier d'état civil) is received by the registrar of the town of Mamoudzou, unless it is made at the same time as the birth registration (article 2496 of the Civil Code).
When a child born in Mayotte is recognized, the person making the recognition is informed of their obligations toward the child (support, upbringing) and of the penalties for fraudulent recognition.

If there is doubt about whether the recognition is genuine, the public prosecutor (procureur) can suspend its registration for 2 months, renewable once (3 months if the investigation is carried out abroad) (article 2497 of the Civil Code).

A recognition made only to obtain a residence permit or French nationality is a criminal offense (article L. 823-11 of the code de l'entrée et du séjour des étrangers, the French immigration code); the law of August 11, 2025 raised the fine to €75,000.
Recognition is free at the town hall (mairie). It is also possible with a notary, for a fee.

A father who recognizes the child after their first birthday does not exercise parental authority. He can obtain it through a joint declaration with the mother (cerfa n° 12785, sent to the court registry (greffe) of the tribunal judiciaire (judicial court)) or by applying to the family court judge (juge aux affaires familiales, JAF).
Recognition does not change the child's surname by itself: choosing the name requires a separate declaration.
